# Lost Land Adventure: the gun camera spot to send so that the game draws player N's crosshair on a given screen point.
# An INVERSE lattice over the screen (x, y = screen 0..1, step 0.05; each spot line is one y row of u v pairs), see dome_grid.h.
# Built by closed-loop measurement: for each screen node the spot was sent, the crosshair found in a gamescope screenshot (hot-pink
# ring centre dot), and the spot corrected until it landed on the node; a local quadratic fit over 1205 measured crosshair positions.
# Nodes the game never draws a crosshair at (outside its dome picture: the screen's top edge band, the lower corners, y > 0.97) hold
# the spot of the nearest reachable node, so the crosshair stops at the picture's edge instead of jumping.
# Measured 2026-10-22. Player 2 has the same lattice with its own offset in the lower band (y >= 0.75): the game draws player 2's
# crosshair up to 4.4 % of the screen lower there (measured at x 0.1..0.5), up to 1.3 % less spot v and 0.5 % less spot u at x <= 0.3 needed; the offset fades out
# to the right (x 0.6..0.8).
